course_name_original: Solution of Basic Problems of Solids Mechanics by FEM
course_name_en: Solution of Basic Problems of Solids Mechanics by FEM
prerequisites: function of one and more variables

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to work with ANSYS Workbench software.
Understanding of the correct level of the computational model (inclusion of essential variables).
Gain basic theoretical and practical knowledge of the Finite Element Method.
Learn how to use it for solving continuum mechanics problems in complicated two- and three dimensional regions.

syllabus_topics: Plane elements: Plane stress, plane strain and axisymmetric
Creation of mesh, control of mesh density, influence of discretization on results
Solution of dynamic problems – modal, harmonic and transient problems
Basic knowledge on the "art of modelling"
Finding natural frequencies and mode shapes
Solving of a given project under the supervision of lecturer
Presentation of project work by students

assessment_methods.method: knowledge check in the form of a test task
individual preparation and presentation of seminar assignments

assessment_rules: The graded course-unit credit requires active participation in seminars, a knowledge check via a test task, individual preparation and presentation of seminar assignments, and good results in a written test of basic knowledge. The teacher will specify the exact assessment form in the first week. Attendance at practical training is obligatory; unexcused absence results in not awarding the course-unit credit.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
